pin.headline: A glossy daytime balm with a sheer tint
pin.sub: Shea butter · Pocket-sized tube · Berry pink tint

scenes.line: Lipstick feels like effort, and clear balm feels like nothing? Try this middle ground.
It's the LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm. A sheer tint and a glossy finish, with shea butter, in a squeeze tube.
It's made for daytime. You can put it on without a mirror, and the tube fits a pocket, desk drawer, or gym bag.

scenes.title: SHADE TIP
scenes.note: Check the selected shade on Amazon before you buy.
scenes.line: Shade tip: Berry is a sheer pink. For something closer to your natural lip color, look at Vanilla or Grapefruit.
It's pick number five. Find the link on our channel, under Video Picks.
